# Feature: add keyboard shortcuts for the workspace

Labels: enhancement, accessibility

## Problem

Power users editing prompts and test cases move slowly when every action requires pointer input.

## Proposed improvement

Add keyboard shortcuts for:

- run evaluation
- add test case
- save prompt version
- switch between workspace and results

## Acceptance criteria

- shortcuts are discoverable in the UI
- shortcuts do not conflict with common browser behavior
- focus management remains accessible
